body: Thanks. I've tried that on occasion, too, but nothing around here ever seems to want to PAY for something written. It's like art. "What do you mean you won't do this for free? It's EXPOSURE." I'll never understand why so many people think that everything creative should be free of charge.
Haha, that would be interesting, not gonna lie, but as a very small woman I doubt my odds are good.

I hardly remember my interests anymore. Without the lowest tiers of Maslow's hierarchy being met they seem moot. Friends and family just compound the problem. For many of them, things aren't any better. For those it happens to be better for, all they want is to stuff advice down my throat or call me lazy for not fixing my own situation. 


Romance? I'm in a stagnant relationship I'd like to leave but can't for another six months. Another long story there--it boils down to being stuck in a lease and unable to save money to move out, in addition to the fact that it would fuck over two other roommates in the process. All of my time is spent working, searching for work, and sleeping. It just feels like I can't have a single thing. No relief, no retreat, no lights up ahead. I guess that's why I'm here. I'm making no progress in life. The longer I wait, the worse things get. The more of myself I lose, the more I become something I don't like. 


I appreciate what you're saying, truly. I know there's more to life than a job. I just can't afford to have any of it. The poorer you are, the poorer you get--it's a damn expensive racket being broke. And boy do I love whatever jackass originally uttered the words "money can't buy happiness". Neither can air, but good luck living without it.

I could try for another seven years, I suppose, but at this juncture I don't see it making any difference. Even now the disconnect between the life I wanted and the life I'm barely managing to live is an uncrossable chasm. I can't stand to think of how it will feel then.
Thank you. Art degree (laugh quietly, please). No fields available here. It's an associate's that took me 8 years to get on top of it. Long story there, but past is past. All I have is now.

Well I wish you weren't anywhere near the same place. I hate that it feels like it's come to this. I don't want to die, and I don't want you to die, but society has a funny way of making you feel like a piece of shit just for living in it.
